timing.note: Coulomb counting every 1 ms of virtual time: state of charge falls with the current drawn and rises while charged. Real time by default; prop speedup multiplies it (labelled ×N) so tests can watch hours in seconds.

analog.note: Typical LiPo resting-voltage curve (4.20 V full, 3.84 V at 50 %, 3.27 V empty) plus internal resistance (~0.15 Ω for 500 mAh, scaled by capacity, doubling near empty), so it sags under load. No recovery after a load, temperature, ageing or C-rate capacity loss.

power.note: Protection board cuts the cell off below 2.5 V and reconnects when a charger lifts the pack voltage; over-current trip is only a warning (> 2C), not a cut-off. Warns on charging above 1C and above 4.25 V.

emulates: Discharge and charge over time (mAh counting)
doesNotEmulate: Voltage recovery after a heavy load
Ageing and capacity loss at high current
The protection board's over-current and short-circuit trip (it only warns)
testOnRealDevice: Real run time: measure the average current of your device and divide the capacity by it, then keep a 20 % margin
The voltage your firmware reads near empty (3.3–3.5 V) and that it shuts down in time
Charge only with a LiPo charger; never leave a charging LiPo unattended
